screens.penny: Hi, {name}! Today we'll learn about needs and wants!

cards.caption: Something we must have to stay safe and healthy.
A fun extra. Nice, but we're okay without it.

screens.prompt: It's snowing outside. Is a warm coat a need or a want?
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! A coat keeps us warm and safe. That's a need!
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! See how the coat keeps her warm in the snow? That makes it a need.

screens.prompt: You are thirsty on a hot day. Is water a need or a want?
screens.rightMessage: That's it, {name}! Our bodies need water to stay healthy.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! We can't stay healthy without water, so water is a need.

screens.prompt: Put each picture in the right basket.
screens.pennyHint: Take your time, {name}. Drag a picture, or tap it and tap a basket.
screens.rightMessage: Nice sorting, {name}! That one belongs there.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Look at the picture again. Do we need it to stay safe and healthy?
screens.doneMessage: All sorted, {name}! Needs keep us safe. Wants are fun extras.

screens.title: Lesson done, {name}!
screens.message: You kept trying, and you got it!
